bio: A stone’s throw from the emblematic Champs Elysées, this establishment is just the ticket to try China’s imperial cuisine: sharing, lavish ingredients and time-honoured, even ancestral, recipes. Beneath the watchful eye of a head chef assisted by a kitchen brigade, as talented as they are numerous, each dish becomes a tribute to tradition: Peking duck exquisitely carved by your tableside, dim sum to die for, or chicken in Chinese yellow wine steeped in suave, subtle flavours. In a setting with a sense of occasion, each diner is pampered by a zealous front-of-house team, who also plays the role of guide, pointing out the highlights of this divinely refined Asian universe. The perfect place to sample dishes of rare authenticity....
